ranks.tabRanks: The ranks and what each one allows. Pick a rank to edit its name, colour and permissions, or create a new one.
ranks.tabStaff: Who holds which rank. Give a rank to a player or take it away, online or not.
ranks.list: Every rank, highest order first. Press a rank to open it in the editor.

col.rank: The rank's display name and colour, with the fixed name the server uses under it.
col.members: How many people hold this rank now.

ranks.new: Opens an empty editor for a new rank. Nothing is saved until you press Create rank.
ranks.editor: Edit one of the website roles. Member permissions refresh automatically after saving.
ranks.editorNew: A new rank: give it a fixed name, a display name, a colour and an order, then switch on the permissions it should have.

name.text: The fixed name of the rank: lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, 2 to 32 long. It cannot change after the rank is created.

ranks.label: The displayed rank name, 1 to 60 characters.

color.text: The rank's colour as #rrggbb. It shows as a dot beside its name in the panel.

ranks.colorPreset: Ready colours: pick one and the colour box fills with it.
ranks.sort: The rank's order, 0 to 999. A higher number is listed first.
ranks.master: This role exceeds your delegable permissions. You cannot edit, delete or assign it.
ranks.danger: This role includes sensitive actions such as money changes or role management. Check the person and selected permissions.
ranks.perms: The permissions the rank gives. Each switch opens one thing in the scripts or the commands.
ranks.permSearch: Filters the permissions by name, description or key. Example: type ban.
ranks.group: A group of related permissions. Switch on only the ones the rank needs.
ranks.node: One permission. When it is on, everyone with the rank can use it.
ranks.custom: Enter only a website or reported script permission you may delegate. This field cannot create global administrative authority.

customInput.text: A permission available to you, up to 146 characters. Example: w_stables:w_stables.admin.

ranks.customAdd: Adds the typed permission to the rank. It is kept only when you save.
ranks.customRemove: Removes this permission from the rank. It is kept only when you save.

save.text: Saves the rank and applies it at once to everyone who holds it.
save.undo: Yes, edit it and save again

ranks.discard: Puts the fields back to the last saved version without saving anything.
ranks.cancelNew: Closes the new rank editor without creating the rank.

delete.text: Deletes the rank for good and takes it from everyone who holds it.
delete.undo: No, you would have to create it again and give it out again

ranks.confirmDelete: Confirms deleting the rank. When it has members you type its fixed name, so it is not deleted by mistake.
ranks.discardChanges: You have unsaved changes on the current rank. They are lost if you go on.
ranks.loadFailed: Could not load the website roles. Check the connector link and try again.
ranks.saveFailed: The server refused the save and nothing changed. Read the reason, fix the field and save again.

staff.search: Filters the list by name, identifier or rank name.

filter.all: Everyone who holds a rank, online or not.
filter.online: Only those in the server right now.
filter.offline: Only those not in the server right now.

col.name: The person and Discord identifier used by their website roles.
col.online: Online now with the session number, or offline.
col.ranks: The person’s roles. The × removes a role; a lock means it exceeds your management authority.
col.give: Pick a rank and press Give to add it to this person at once.

revoke.text: Remove this website role. Permissions refresh automatically, and disallowed actions fail their next authorization check.

staff.locked: This role exceeds your delegable permissions. You cannot edit, delete or assign it.
staff.give: Choose an online player or paste a Discord user ID, then select the website role to assign.
staff.source: How to pick the person: from those online now, or by typing the identifier of someone offline.
staff.player: The online player to give the rank to. Search by name, session number or citizen ID.

identifier.text: The Discord user ID. Enable Discord developer mode and copy the user ID; digits alone are accepted.

staff.idName: A name to show in the staff list until the person joins. Optional.

giveBtn.text: Gives the rank to the chosen person; its permissions open for them at once.
giveBtn.undo: Yes, take it back from the staff list

staff.confirmGive: Confirms giving a powerful rank. Make sure of the person before you go on.
staff.confirmRevoke: Confirms taking the rank from the person.

ranks.name: Fixed name
ranks.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (2 to 32). It cannot change later.
ranks.nameBad: The name does not match the rule
ranks.nameTaken: A rank with this name already exists
ranks.label: Display name
ranks.masterText: This role exceeds the permissions you may delegate. Only the owner or someone with its permissions may change or assign it.
ranks.dangerText: The rank includes %s. These open almost everything, so give it only to people you trust.
ranks.noCatalog: The server sent no permission list. You can still add permissions by hand below.
ranks.customBad: Bad format: letters, digits and _ . - only, 64 characters at most
ranks.customReserved: Reserved: it cannot start with wranks. or wrank.
ranks.deleteText: The rank is deleted for good.
ranks.deleteMembers: It is also taken from everyone who holds it (%s).
ranks.discardText: You have unsaved changes on this rank. They are lost if you go on.
ranks.pickRank: Pick a rank from the list to edit it, or create a new one.
ranks.needFix: Fix the marked fields before saving

staff.search: Search by name, identifier or rank…
staff.identifierBad: Enter a Discord user ID of 15 to 21 digits.
staff.giveText: This role includes sensitive actions such as money changes or role management. Check the person and selected permissions.
staff.noneNext: Pick a player above and give them a rank.

need.name: the fixed name (small English letters)
need.free: a fixed name not in use
need.label: the shown name
